# Face2social Built a Face Search Engine That Refuses to Search the Whole Internet — On Purpose

Face2social is a US-only face recognition search engine.

By David Wright· Published  ·3 min read

Face2social — company facts

| Category | Consumer |
| Founder | David Anderson, Founder |
| Website | face2social.com |

## What does Face2social do?

Face2social is a US-only face recognition search engine. Users upload a photo, and it matches facial features against public profile pictures on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and X, returning candidate profiles in about 30 seconds. It is used to verify online dates and to find fake accounts reusing someone's photos. [...] ## The Face2social solution

Face2social converts an uploaded photo into a facial embedding and searches it against an index of public profile pictures from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and X. Because the comparison is on facial geometry rather than pixels, matches survive cropping, filters, resolution loss and changes of angle — the exact failure modes that defeat conventional reverse image search. Queries return in roughly 30 seconds, run in the browser, and require no app install.
